name: State Opera South Australia under 30 and student tickets
summary: $35 tickets to selected State Opera SA productions for under 30s, plus concession prices for full-time students.
key: If you're under 30 years old, you can access specially priced tickets to selected State Opera productions for just $35.
who: Under 30 with proof of age, or a full-time student for concession prices.
how: Book early, as availability is limited.
catches: Selected performances only, usually in designated seating.

source.label: State Opera SA: Great value opera

evidence.quote: If you're under 30 years old, you can access specially priced tickets to selected State Opera productions for just $35.
If you're studying full-time, you can access concession pricing on many State Opera performances.
